stem: Which statement about \( k(x) = -x^2 - 2x + 15 \) is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The zeros are \(-3\) and 5, because \( k(x) = -(x + 3)(x - 5) \).

options.label: G
options.text: The zeros are \(-5\) and 3, because \( k(x) = -(x + 5)(x - 3) \).

options.label: H
options.text: The zeros are \(-5\) and \(-3\), because \( k(x) = -(x + 5)(x + 3) \).

options.label: J
options.text: The zeros are 3 and 5, because \( k(x) = -(x - 3)(x - 5) \).
